name: Coordinator loop-failed (lineage anchor) → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — the coordinator zombie-hole closer, anchor branch 2 of 2 (loops carrying agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id). Sibling of rule 05. A coordinator spawned by a rule firing ON the run entity (dev-via-test/02d plan-retry escalate, dev-via-test/07d cbg-retry re-dispatch + escalate) carries agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id=$entity.id=chain.execution (threaded by those drivers) but NOT agent.run.entity-id — because the run entity has no bare agent.run triple for the inherit path to copy into RunID, so the spawn-identity writer never stamps agent.run.entity-id (verified graph_writer.go:535-539; same asymmetry as re-plan Lisa, dev-via-test 02g). The dev-via-test intermediate wake-ups (02b, 05) carry BOTH anchors and are routed HERE by the fence so they stamp via lineage.

FIRING-ENTITY BRIDGE: same 2-step marker as rule 05 — stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the run entity via $entity.triple.agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id; rule 04 consumes it.

ANCHOR FENCE (length_gt 0): mutually exclusive with rule 05 (length_eq 0). agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id PRESENCE is itself the run guard (a plain-chat coordinator has no lineage), so no separate run-less-chat condition is needed.

TRIGGER SHAPE: agent.loop.outcome IN [failed, truncated] — the involuntary terminal-failure class. A coordinator that successfully decides terminates outcome=success and never matches. cancelled is OUT of scope (Phase 4b).

metadata.covers: the lineage-threading coordinators: (1) the dev-via-test intermediate/escalate coordinators 02b + 05 (carry both anchors, routed here by the length_gt 0 fence) and 02d/07d (spawned FROM the run entity, carry only lineage); (2) the run-entity-descended ask_user/needs_clarification recovery coordinators that ADR-053 4b-1a wired to thread agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id — autoresearch/10b and dev-via-test 02e, 02f-replan, 07b, 07e (the former deferred_4b set). The anchor_inherit recovery coordinators (research/06, autoresearch/10 baseline, dev-via-test/02f first-pass) route to sibling rule 05. Boundary pinned by TestAgentRunPack_CoordinatorSpawnCoverage.
metadata.anchor_fence: agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_gt 0 — mutually exclusive with rule 05 (length_eq 0). The lineage presence is itself the run-less-chat guard.
metadata.d3_boundary: Same as rule 05: this rule stamps the failed marker; rules 04 (executing) and 04b (dispatched — beta.160 D3-guard replacement) consume it, disjoint by phase guard.
